design.note: Geometric candidate; slicing and removal validation required

geometry.label: contact_exact_03
geometry.removal_policy: Fins have no downward-facing area above the build plate, hence every fin column continues to the bed. After severing the short teeth they can withdraw toward the bed without crossing the unchanged part. Empty functional clearances must be completely cleaned before assembly.
